indications_and_usage: Indications & Usage Section High protection against sunburn
warnings: - For external use only - Do not use on damaged or broken skin - When using this product, keep out of eyes. - Rinse with water to remove. - Stop use and ask a doctor if rash occurs - Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control right away
dosage_and_administration: - Apply generously 15 minutes before sun exposure - Reapply every 2 hours - Use a water-resistant sunscreen if swimming or sweating
